# FFmpeg decoder source

Unmodified FFmpeg 8.0.1 source from https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.0.1.tar.xz.
SHA-256: `05ee0b03119b45c0bdb4df654b96802e909e0a752f72e4fe3794f487229e5a41`.

The archive contains the complete source and original license texts. `scripts/build-decoder.sh` verifies its digest and builds a minimal LGPL 2.1-or-later executable with network support disabled. No downloaded binaries, GPL or nonfree components are used. The app includes this archive, the build script and LGPL text so recipients can rebuild/modify the separate decoder. See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
